parts.note_add: Catalogue (S-005 BI p125, fig 6860A-1) lists the front mat FA01-68-671B in black 00, red 11, brown 70 only. No new Mazda carpet found; reproduction is a molded 79-85 RX-7 kit (Stock Interiors complete kit, passenger area plus rear cargo, heat-and-pressure molded to the floor pan, jute padding bonded on, USD 278.95 in plush cut pile on 2026-09-27; ACC make the same kit).

Catalogue (S-005 BI p125) splits the rear mat four ways: FA02-68-677 (small rear console) and FA01-68-677 (large console) for the '81 model, serial 500001-600000; FA02-68-677A (small console) and FA03-68-677 (large console) for '82 and '83, both in black 00, red 11, brown 70, tan 72. Reproduction: the Stock Interiors 79-85 passenger-area carpet (molded) covers it.

Reproduction: Stock Interiors 79-85 RX-7 rear deck carpet, molded, no padding, USD 124.95 (2026-09-27); RayBuck sells the same cargo area as a 1/8 in textured non-skid vinyl mat. No new Mazda mat found.

Catalogue (S-005 BI p130, fig 6900A-3): FA01-69-760 is the '81 and '82 box, FA42-69-760A the '83; tan 29 from serial 600001. Used only; no new or reproduction box found (eBay rear-interior category is the place to watch).

Owners on rx7club say the two cargo-room straps are cinch-buckle straps sized to hold the lift-off sunroof panel in the cargo area, not general loads; the catalogue fits them to every car (fig 6900A-2/3). Colours black 00, wine 10, brown 20, tan 29 (tan from serial 600001).
Same as strap A: cinch-buckle strap for the lift-off sunroof panel (rx7club); colours black 00, wine 10, brown 20, tan 29 (tan from serial 600001) (S-005 BI p130).

Catalogue (S-005 BI p129, fig 6900A-2): black 02, red 10, tan 28 (from serial 600001), brown 70. Used only: Autopartone lists an 81-83 black OEM pair at USD 68 (sold out 2026-09-27); single visors appear on eBay. The 1985 manual (S-002 sec 14 p14-13) has the visors and the mirror off before the headliner comes out.

Catalogue (S-005 BI p129): 8341-69-320 is the normal-roof left visor, FA04-69-320 the sunroof one; colours black 02, red 10, tan 28 (from serial 600001), brown 70. Used only (Autopartone 81-83 pair, eBay).

The mirror houses the car's interior (dome) light and the map (spot) light: catalogue fig 6900A-2 (S-005 BI p129) gives it lens FA01-51-351A, bulb 0000-11-3175 (A12V 10W) for the interior lamp, and for the GS/GSL map lamp the socket and holder FA01-51-354, spot lamp FA01-51-355A and bulb 0000-11-0194 (A12V 5W). S-001 sec H draws it as H-06 'interior and spot light': one 5 W lamp on a three-way switch (on / door / off) and one 6 W spot lamp on its own switch, fed by LY from the 15 A constant fuse with RY to the door switches - the wattages in the two sources disagree, check the bulbs fitted. Lens new at Atkins (USD 41.50); owners (rx7club) say the white lens pulls off, two Phillips screws hold the assembly and one of them grounds the switch contact, which breaks with age.

The 1985 manual (S-002 sec G p9) draws the chassis number plate on top of the firewall in the engine bay; rx7club owners say the 1st gen has a screw-on data plate under the hood, the chassis number stamped into the firewall (right or left by vintage), a driver's door-post sticker with the VIN and build date, and a dash tag visible through the windscreen. Which of these is 8595-69-011B and where it sits on this car - check.

Almost certainly the FMVSS certification sticker: rx7club owners place a sticker with the VIN, build date and other data on the driver's door post on every 1st gen after early 1979. Location on this car - check.

specs.item: Interior lamp bulb (figure callout 69170J, Mazda 0000-11-3175): rating
specs.note: Marked A12V 10W; fitted to both the with- and without-map-lamp mirrors. S-001 draws the interior lamp as 5 W - check the bulb fitted.

specs.item: Map (spot) lamp bulb (figure callout 69170K, Mazda 0000-11-0194): rating
specs.note: Marked A12V 5W; GS and GSL only. The same Mazda number is marked A12V 3.4W in fig 5540A-1 (BI p49) and is the trade 194 wedge. S-001 draws the spot lamp as 6 W - check the bulb fitted.

specs.item: Interior lamp as drawn in the wiring diagram
specs.note: Sec H, H-06 'interior and spot light': the 5 W lamp is on the three-way switch (on / door / off). Catalogue bulb is 10 W.

specs.item: Spot (map) lamp as drawn in the wiring diagram
specs.note: Sec H, H-06: the 6 W spot lamp has its own on/off switch to ground. Catalogue bulb is 5 W.

specs.item: Supply fuse (LY, constant from the battery through the fusible link)
specs.note: Fuse block X-04 15 A, shared with the cigarette lighter, clock, luggage compartment light and ignition switch light. Works with the key out.

specs.item: Interior lamp switch positions (from the wiring diagram)
specs.note: On: lamp to ground in the mirror; door: lamp to RY, grounded by the door switches H-07/H-08; off: open. Confirm on the car.
The page lists it as 13 V for 12 V applications; owners on rx7club fit the Sylvania DE3175 as the dome bulb.

specs.item: Replacement DE-3175 festoon: base and size
specs.value: SV8.5-8 festoon, 10.5 x 32 mm, C-8 filament

specs.item: Chassis number plate location (1985 manual drawing)
specs.value: top of the firewall in the engine bay
specs.note: Drawing 47U0GX-027 only; no 1982 source shows it. Check where this car's plate is.

terminals.inside: To the 5 W interior lamp and, through its own switch, the 6 W spot lamp
